errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по размер във визуално низходящ ред, започвайки от най-големия.
errors.evidence: The description states that the sectors are arranged in descending order of size. However, visually, starting from the top and moving clockwise, the sectors are arranged in ascending order of size: 4% (orange), 15% (yellow), 20% (green), and 61% (brown).
